notes: UNV text provided in the prompt was missing explicit SN tags; tags were reconstructed from standard Hebrew source text.
LCC 天穹 ('heavenly vault') incorporates both H7549 (firmament) and H8064 (heavens) which UNV splits as 天+空.
LCC 發光之體 explicitly translates H3974 (מאורות), whereas UNV simply uses 發光.
Prefix markers (WAH09001 for ל, WAH09002 for ב) follow the pattern of attaching to the Chinese word corresponding to the Hebrew prefix function.
